title: Council-led planning, with the next action clear
summary: V22 keeps the restored V12 farm workspace and brings the Council forward: short public roles, explicit questions, readable findings, a skippable illustrated introduction, and recoverable planning drafts.

changes.title: Council roles lead planning
changes.description: Demand Planner, Crop Planner, Weather & Risk, Market Analyst, Resource Planner, Supply Planner and Chair now appear as short public roles while preserving durable advisor IDs, historical transcripts and numerical authority.

changes.title: Guided first decision without a separate tutorial
changes.description: A captioned, skippable 30-second illustration explains the normal planning workflow, then contextual actions lead to calculation, review, simulated approval, reported results and recovery without locking the farm.

changes.title: Discussions and plan changes recover safely
changes.description: Council threads bind to the reviewed result, drafts survive reload, rate limits retain input, and a lost apply response reconciles the exact original proposal without duplicate work.
